title: Simulation over multiple cycles
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet, let $E$ injectively code optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols as blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e:\{0,1\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding. For a finite-state $k$-tape machine $M$, a binary input $x$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the binary block-code simulator for $(3(N+1)+2)t$ steps from the encoding of $c$ yields the encoding of the configuration reached after $t$ steps of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Injective code $E$ of optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols into $(N+1)$-entry optional-bit blocks
